# J118 floating checkpoint recovery capsule part 2/3 — finite cut and replacement

Complete binary64 arrays, without rounding. New CP_ wrappers are not aliases of original receipt-file bytes. Full producing methods/parameters/dependencies are in [internal-source-reference] and [internal-source-reference]. Part1 supplies earlier class-flow inputs; part3 supplies independent Q-only fragmentation controls. These two checkpoints are directly sufficient to continue finite surgery. CP_CUTREPAIR118_6 has numerical S1/U2,Q[],P.32434860024843143,136/204/70. CP_SURGERYREPAIR118_0 follows replacement of its newly added support69, retains136/204/70 and improves numerical P to.32319788589208537. Rounding the latter to the literal G6/G7 rational inputs produced the exact own121 bodies preserved separately in [internal-source-reference] plus exact115.cpp. No own110.

Save the JSON block including final newline as CP118_PART2.json (9077 bytes,SHA256 fefc4d80256a13d12bd1fb84069a89c7dd7aa4a8d902173508df26ad9d8134c1). Complete reconstruction/check:
```python
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
b=Path('CP118_PART2.json').read_bytes()
assert len(b)==9077 and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='fefc4d80256a13d12bd1fb84069a89c7dd7aa4a8d902173508df26ad9d8134c1'
for name,r in json.loads(b).items():
    z=(json.dumps({'normals':r['normals']},separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
    assert len(z)==r['checkpoint_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(z).hexdigest()==r['checkpoint_sha256']
    Path(name).write_bytes(z)
print('J118_FLOAT_CHECKPOINT_PART2_EXACT_BYTES_PASS 2')
```
